# App Blueprints: Full LLM Context Engine

This document contains the unrolled summary of all architecture standards, patterns, and code snippets in the `belal-waheed/app-blueprints` repository for direct injection into LLM context windows.

---

## 1. Authentication & Password Recovery Wizard
- **Frontend:** 3-stage wizard (`forgot_request` -> `forgot_otp` -> `forgot_new_password`) using Framer Motion directional slide variants.
- **OTP Input:** 6 individual cells with auto-focus advancing, backspace handling, clipboard paste sanitization, and auto-submit on the 6th digit.
- **Backend:** `POST /api/auth/forgot-password` (6-digit code, 15-min TTL), `POST /api/auth/verify-code` (code validation), `POST /api/auth/reset-password` (PBKDF2 hashing).

---

## 2. Offline-First PWA Sync & Android 12 Share Target
- **Storage:** Dexie.js (IndexedDB) with local-first reads/writes.
- **Sync Protocol:** Bidirectional sync using Last-Write-Wins (LWW) timestamp comparison (`record.updatedAt > local.updatedAt`).
- **Tombstone Deletion:** Deleted records store `isDeleted: true` to prevent resurrection.
- **Cross-Tab Live Reactivity:** `new BroadcastChannel('app-sync-channel')` triggers instant UI updates across browser tabs.
- **Android Web Share Target:** PWA manifest configures `share_target: { action: '/share', method: 'GET', params: { title: 'title', text: 'text', url: 'url' } }` for sub-50ms link capturing.

---

## 3. Universal Media & Link Metadata Scraper
- **Tier 1 (Fast-Path APIs):** GitHub API + social card preview, Wikipedia summary API, YouTube oEmbed, Spotify oEmbed, Reddit JSON, AniList GraphQL.
- **Tier 2 (HTML & Schema.org):** Extracts OpenGraph (`og:image`), Twitter cards (`twitter:image`), Schema.org JSON-LD (`Article`, `Product`, `VideoObject`).
- **Tier 3 (Anti-Bot Bypass):** Microlink API fallback for Cloudflare Turnstile or JS-rendered websites.

---

## 4. Native Back-Button Navigation Protection
- **Problem:** Pressing hardware/browser Back in a PWA closes the application instead of the open modal dialog.
- **Solution:** `useModalBackNavigation` hook pushes `history.pushState({ modalOpen: true }, "")` on open and closes the modal on `popstate`.
